title: Multi-Modal Cross-Domain Alignment Network for Video Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: In this paper, we focus on a novel task: cross-domain VMR, where fully-annotated datasets are available in one domain (“source domain”), but the domain of interest (“target domain”) only contains unannotated datasets.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: However, due to the domain discrepancy between the source and target domains and the semantic gap between videos and queries, directly applying trained models to the target domain generally leads to a performance drop.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: Most previous methods depend heavily on numerous manual annotations (i.e., moment boundaries), which are extremely expensive to acquire in practice.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: By jointly training these three modules, our MMCDA can learn domain-invariant and semantic-aligned cross-modal representations.
